headline: Building on Volcanic Ground: Architecture's Response to Volcanic Landscapes
context: Volcanic landscapes make geological change unusually visible. Lava hardens into new ground, and plants slowly take hold across it. Ash can remain in the landscape for years. Around active volcanoes, these processes are still underway, affecting where and how people build.
